Intern - Software Developer

Location: 

Bethpage, NY, US, 11714

Brand:  Optimum
Requisition #:  12508

Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!

 

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. 

 

At Optimum, co-op/intern students work on real projects with real business impact. Participants gain hands-on experience, collaborate with industry professionals, and contribute to initiatives that help shape the future of connectivity, technology, and customer experiences. Students may work on meaningful projects, gain exposure to industry-leading technologies, partner with mentors, develop professional skills, and build networks across the organization.

 

Program Details 

  • Full-time co-op/intern opportunity (Jan 2027 - Jul 2027) 
  • 40-hour work week
  • 30-minute unpaid lunch period each workday

 

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!   

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Software Developer Co-op to join a software engineering team. You will pair with experienced developers to design, build, test, and deploy backend services and APIs. Assignments may focus on Python, Go, Java, or both, depending on team needs and your strengths.
This is a hands-on role: you will write production code, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot issues in shared environments, and learn how a mature software organization delivers on GCP using Cursor, GitLab and Atlassian.

Responsibilities

•    Implement features, bug fixes, and small services under the guidance of a mentor and tech lead
•    Write clean, tested code in Python, following team conventions and secure coding standards
•    Build and run services on Google Cloud Platform (e.g., Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager—exposure varies by team)
•    Use GitLab for source control, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, and code review
•    Track work in Jira, document decisions in Confluence, and participate in agile ceremonies
•    Contribute to automated tests and help keep pipelines green
•    Investigate defects and learn observability basics (logging, metrics, alerts)
•    Present your work at an end-of-term demo or knowledge-sharing session

Qualifications

Required

  • Enrolled in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related co-op program
  • Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and at least one programming language
  • Familiarity with Git (branching, commits, merge requests)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication

Preferred

  • Experience with Go and/or Java
  • Exposure to REST APIs, JSON, and SQL
  • Cloud computing or Linux command-line experience
  • Familiarity with Docker, GitLab, and Jira

Technologies & Tools

Languages: Python
Cloud: Google Cloud Platform
DevOps: GitLab (repos, MRs, CI/CD)
Planning: Atlassian Jira, Confluence

How We Work
Agile squads with two-week sprints, trunk-based development via GitLab merge requests, mandatory code review, CI quality gates, dedicated mentorship, and security-first practices (no secrets in code).

What You Will Gain
Production experience on GCP, fluency with GitLab and Atlassian, backend/API and cloud-native patterns, professional code review skills, and a portfolio of real merge requests.

At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop.

 

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.
